response.sql:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_of_rating_averages
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT ra.rating,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day - oa.mean_of_rating_averages AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages AS ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE oa.mean_of_rating_averages IS NOT NULL
  AND ra.avg_rate_per_day > oa.mean_of_rating_averages;

alternatives.interpretation: If “under the 20.99 cutoff” means strictly less than 20.99, use this predicate instead.
